name: Overburden
tagline: Stake the seam, survey the risk, mine before your rivals do.
core_loop: Stake claim cards onto adjacent cells of a face-down 4x4 ore grid, survey a cell to learn its ore, or mine a cell you dominate to bank its value and take it as territory.
win_condition: Highest total of banked ore values plus 5 points per row or column you own outright when the field or the deck runs out.
